meta.what: Real Goals' Bangers: famous goals 2010-2025, drafted by Knowitball from public record (match reports named per goal). Names as labels only.
meta.frame: our pitch metres: x 0..68 from the attacker's left touchline, y from the attacked goal line

xg_model.features: 1, ln(distance m), goal-mouth angle (rad), header, direct free kick

goals.label: Lewandowski v Wolfsburg — the fifth in nine minutes
goals.checked: Half-time sub; Caligiuri had put Wolfsburg 1-0 up; five goals 51-60 min; fifth on 60 min, 4-1 to 5-1, acrobatic volley from a Götze cross past Benaglio. | Pass 2: 5th goal ~60' (one report 61'), 4-1 -> 5-1, volley on the full from Götze's cross from the right (FC Bayern report).
goals.note: Corner and foot not stated in sources; placement estimated.

goals.label: Lewandowski v Augsburg — the record 41st
goals.checked: Last league game; goals Gouweleeuw og 9, Gnabry 22, Kimmich 33, Coman 43, Hahn 67, Niederlechner 72, Lewandowski 90 (4-2 to 5-2); Gikiewicz could not hold a Sané shot, Lewandowski took it past him and finished; ESPN: right foot, centre of box, centre of goal. | Pass 2: 90', 4-2 -> 5-2, Gikiewicz parried Sané's low shot, Lewandowski picked it up, rounded the keeper and slotted into an empty net (41st goal).
goals.note: The 'P' from Sané is really his parried shot; spots estimated.

goals.label: Xhaka v Bremen — the title-day rocket
goals.checked: Boniface pen ~25 min (1-0); Xhaka 60 min, first-time left foot from ~25 m, set up by Boniface (2-0); Wirtz hat-trick; 5-0 sealed first title; Zetterer in goal. | Pass 2: 60', 1-0 -> 2-0, first-time left-foot curler from ~25 yards after Boniface's pass (Planet Sport).
goals.note: Corner not given in any report found; end is a guess.

goals.label: Kane v Darmstadt — from his own half
goals.technique: lob from inside his own half
goals.checked: Kane collected near the centre circle, saw Schuhen off his line and lobbed him from inside his own half; made it 5-0; AP 69th min (CNN 68th); 8-0 final; second of his hat-trick. | Pass 2: 69' (FC Bayern), made it 5-0 (4-0 before), lobbed Schuhen who was far off his line from just beyond halfway.
goals.note: Spot in his own half (y 54) on purpose. Build-up not confirmed, shown as his own carry.

goals.label: Ben Arfa v Saint-Étienne — the solo slalom
goals.technique: solo run, low finish across goal
goals.checked: Koziello 5, Perrin 19, Ben Arfa 39 and 45+1, Seri 53; solo goal beat several (one report: five) defenders, low across Ruffier from a tight angle into the bottom left corner, on the stroke of half-time (1-2 to 1-3). | Pass 2: 45+1', 1-2 -> 1-3 (Koziello 5', Perrin 19', Ben Arfa 39'), assisted by Koziello (ESPN), dribbled past several defenders and shot low across Ruffier from a tight angle (Sky Sports).
goals.note: Added Koziello's pass at the start (ESPN credits him). Run start and route estimated.

goals.label: Ibrahimović v Bastia — the flying backheel
goals.checked: 10th min, 0-0; Lucas cross from the right hit Ongenda and looped up behind Ibrahimović, who backheeled it in mid-air past Landreau; he scored again minutes later, Cavani two; 4-0. | Pass 2: 10', 0-0, Lucas's cross deflected off Ongenda and looped behind him, backheel volley in mid-air past Landreau (AP, Maxifoot).
goals.note: Which heel and where it went in not stated; the deflection is folded into Lucas's cross.

goals.label: Altıntop v Kazakhstan — the Puskás volley
goals.checked: Away in Astana; Arda 24 (0-1), Altıntop 26 volley from ~25 m off Emre's corner (0-2), Nihat 75 (0-3); Sidelnikov in goal; won the 2010 Puskás Award. | Pass 2: 3 Sep 2010, Astana, 26', 0-1 -> 0-2 (Arda 24'), right-foot volley from Emre's corner, UEFA: 25-metre volley; final 0-3 (Nihat ~75').
goals.note: Spot moved y 23 -> 24.5 to match UEFA's 25 m. Corner side and where it went in estimated.

goals.label: Ibrahimović v England — the 30-yard overhead kick
goals.checked: Opening game at the Friends Arena; Ibrahimović scored all four; fourth at 90+1 (3-2 to 4-2): Hart came out and headed clear, Zlatan hit an overhead kick over him into the empty net from ~30 yards; won the 2013 Puskás. | Pass 2: stoppage time, 3-2 -> 4-2, Hart came out and headed a long ball clear weakly, overhead kick into the empty net (AP).
goals.note: Range varies by report (25 yards to 40 m; AP 30 yards); kept ~27 m. Long-ball passer not confirmed.

goals.label: Van Persie v Spain — the flying header
goals.checked: Xabi Alonso pen 26/27 (1-0); Blind's ~40-yard ball from near halfway, Van Persie dived and looped a header over Casillas (1-1) just before half-time; Netherlands won 5-1. | Pass 2: confirmed by first pass sources; 1-0 -> 1-1, Blind long ball from the left, diving header lob over Casillas.
goals.note: Minute 44 (FIFA), one source 45. Spots estimated.

goals.label: Cahill v Netherlands — the left-foot volley
goals.checked: Robben 20 (0-1); a minute later Cahill volleyed McGowan's long diagonal first time with his weaker left foot from ~11 yards, in off the underside of the bar past Cillessen (1-1); Netherlands won 3-2. | Pass 2: 21', 0-1 -> 1-1 a minute after Robben, McGowan's long ball, left-foot volley in off the bar.
goals.note: Side of the box and exact corner estimated.

goals.label: James v Uruguay — chest and volley
goals.checked: Maracanã, 28th min, 0-0; Aguilar headed it down to James, back to goal at the edge of the box; chest, turn, left-foot volley in off the bar over Muslera; Colombia won 2-0; Goal of the Tournament and 2014 Puskás. | Pass 2: 28', 0-0, headed knock-down, chest control and left-foot volley in off the bar past Muslera.
goals.note: One report credits Cuadrado with the header instead of Aguilar. Spots estimated.

goals.label: Götze v Argentina — the World Cup winner
goals.checked: 113th min of extra time (CBC says 112), 0-0; sub Schürrle ran down the left and crossed, sub Götze chested it and volleyed left-footed from a tight angle inside the far post past Romero; 1-0. | Pass 2: 113', 0-0, Schürrle's cross from the left, chest control and left-foot volley past Romero.
goals.note: Minute 113 (one source 112).

goals.label: Schick v Scotland — from the halfway line
goals.checked: Hampden; Schick header 42 (0-1); 52nd min a Hendry shot was blocked back up field, Schick picked it up on halfway, saw Marshall off his line and lobbed him left-footed (0-2). | Pass 2: Euro 2020 played June 2021, Hampden, 52', 0-1 -> 0-2, from 49.7 m (UEFA, Euro record) after a blocked Scotland shot, Marshall off his line.
goals.note: Where it dropped in estimated.

goals.label: Richarlison v Serbia — the scissor kick
goals.checked: Richarlison rebound 62 (1-0); 73rd min Vinícius crossed with the outside of the boot from the left, Richarlison flicked it up from ~12 yards and scissor-volleyed past Milinković-Savić's right arm (2-0); fans' goal of the tournament. | Pass 2: 73', 1-0 -> 2-0, Vinícius pass from the left, control then scissor-kick volley.
goals.note: Foot inferred (right); corner inferred from 'beyond the keeper's right arm' = shooter's left.

goals.label: Yamal v France — the curler
goals.checked: Munich semi; Kolo Muani header 9 (0-1); Yamal 21st min from just outside the box after an Olmo pass, feinted past Rabiot and curled into the left corner past Maignan (1-1); Olmo 25 (2-1); youngest Euros scorer. | Pass 2: 21', 0-1 -> 1-1 (Kolo Muani 9'), cut in from the right past Rabiot, left foot from outside the box into the far top corner, in off the post (Football365, AP).
goals.note: No assist credited in any source; Olmo pass before his carry kept as a placeholder link. Spots estimated.

goals.label: Bellingham v Slovakia — the 95th-minute overhead kick
goals.checked: Gelsenkirchen; Schranz 25 (0-1); 90+5 Walker long throw from the right, Guéhi flicked on, Bellingham's overhead kick into the bottom corner past Dúbravka (1-1); Kane won it in extra time (2-1). | Pass 2: 90+5', 0-1 -> 1-1, Walker long throw from the right, Guéhi flick-on, overhead kick into the bottom corner, Dúbravka rooted (AP). Round of 16.
goals.note: Which bottom corner not stated; estimated. Walker's throw shown as a 'P'.

goals.label: Rooney v Man City — the overhead kick
goals.checked: Old Trafford, 12 Feb 2011, 2-1 United; Nani opener, Dzeko (deflected off Silva) levelled; Rooney 78th min winner from a Nani cross, acrobatic overhead volley back to goal into the top corner past Hart | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 78th min, Nani cross deflected off Zabaleta, right foot, struck from the penalty spot (PA/Al Jazeera), top corner past Hart.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Ball moved to the penalty spot per PA. Which top corner is still not in any source found. | Earlier: The Scholes pass before Nani's cross is estimated (build-up not in sources). The cross took a deflection; which top corner (shooter's left) is from memory, not a source.

goals.label: Agüero v QPR — 93:20, the title
goals.checked: Etihad, 13 May 2012, final day; 2-2 after Dzeko's stoppage-time header; Agüero laid off to Balotelli, who slipped but returned it; Agüero beat Kenny at 93:20 for 3-2 and the title on goal difference | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 93:20, Agüero to Balotelli, Balotelli fell and prodded it back, Agüero beat one challenge and fired in at the near post; Kenny: shot from about eight yards (FourFourTwo).
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Height at the near post not stated in sources. | Earlier: Clock read 93:20 so minute is 94 (90+4). De Jong's starting pass is from the well-known build-up, not a quoted source. Shot placement (near post, high) estimated.

goals.label: Cissé v Chelsea — outside of the boot
goals.checked: Stamford Bridge, 2 May 2012, 0-2; Cissé scored 19' and in stoppage time (Sky: 94'); from a left-side throw-in Shola Ameobi brought the ball down for Cissé, who struck it with the outside of his right foot from about 37 yards, looping over Čech; MOTD Goal of the Season | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): UEFA: second goal in the 4th minute of added time, swerving strike from wide left; Ameobi chested a throw-in to him; outside of the right boot, looped over Čech (Wikipedia: 37 yards).
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Spot and landing still estimated; throw-in taker not found. | Earlier: Minute 94 per Sky's listing. Throw-in taker not confirmed, so the move starts with Ameobi. Exact spot (left channel, ~34 m) and far-top-corner landing are estimated.

goals.label: Van Persie v Villa — Rooney's long ball
goals.checked: Old Trafford, 22 Apr 2013, 3-0, title-clinching (20th); RVP hat-trick at 2', 13', 33'; the 13th-min goal was a left-foot volley from Rooney's long pass out of his own half, past Guzan | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Rooney long ball from about halfway (Fox: 50 yards), RVP left-foot volley from just outside the box, across Guzan inside the far post (PA).
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Moved the strike to just outside the box (y 17.5) per PA. | Earlier: Rooney's pass start (around halfway, his own half) and the volley spot on the right of the box are estimated; reports vary on pass length.

goals.label: Wilshere v Norwich — the one-twos
goals.checked: Emirates, 19 Oct 2013, 4-1 (Özil 2, Ramsey; Howson for Norwich); Wilshere opener, Cazorla and Giroud combined with him, Giroud's flick, Wilshere side-footed past Ruddy | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Arsenal.com and Duke WCWP: finished with his (weaker) right foot; Duke: first-time into the bottom-left corner. Sequence: Wilshere outside-foot to Cazorla, Cazorla to Giroud, Giroud flick to Wilshere, Wilshere backheel to Giroud, Giroud dink into his path.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Foot changed Left to Right and end moved to bottom left (one source). Pass spots estimated. | Earlier: Minute: Arsenal.com 18', Arseblog/EFE 17'. Exact one-two sequence and the finish's side of goal are estimated from the description.

goals.label: Rooney v West Ham — from halfway
goals.checked: Upton Park, 22 Mar 2014, 0-2 (Rooney 8', 33'); Rooney won the ball near halfway after a challenge with Tomkins and half-volleyed over Adrián, who was off his line | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Won the ball on the halfway line and looped it over Adrián, who was off his line; minute 7 or 8 and 45-58 yards both still reported.

goals.checked: Stamford Bridge, 4 Apr 2015, 2-1 Chelsea (Hazard pen 39', Adam 44', Remy 62'); Adam picked up a loose ball deep in his own half and hit it left-footed; Courtois got a hand to it but it went in | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): ESPN: loose ball deep in his own half a minute before half-time, left foot, 65-66 yards; Hazard pen 39, Remy 62.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): None. | Earlier: Struck from his own half (y > 52.5): ESPN 65 yards, Sky 59 yards; placed at 58 m. Loose ball, so the move is one touch.

goals.label: Alli v Palace — flick and volley
goals.checked: Selhurst Park, 23 Jan 2016, 1-3; 1-1 at 84' when Alli took Eriksen's headed lay-off (after Kane's cross-field ball from the right), flicked it over Jedinak and volleyed past Hennessey for 2-1 | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 84th min, Vertonghen OG then Kane 63 made it 1-1; Eriksen headed pass, flick over Jedinak, volley from about 25 yards into the bottom corner past Hennessey (FA, Tottenham).

Exact spot (~25 yds, central-left) and which low corner are estimated.

goals.checked: Emirates, 1 Jan 2017, 2-0 (Giroud 17', Iwobi 56'); move via Bellerín, Giroud, Xhaka, Iwobi to Sánchez on the left; cross behind Giroud, hooked in with his left heel over Hennessey off the underside of the bar | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Sky: 17th min, left heel, in off the underside of the bar; move from Arsenal's own half, Giroud's earlier touch a backheel flick; Sánchez cross from the left fell behind him.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Pass spots estimated. | Earlier: Pass spots and timings estimated; Sánchez's carry before the cross is assumed. Bar-and-in landing placed just under the bar.

goals.label: Mkhitaryan v Sunderland — the scorpion kick
goals.checked: Old Trafford, Boxing Day 2016, 3-1 (Blind, Ibrahimović, Mkhitaryan; Borini late); sub Mkhitaryan, 86', 2-0 up, flicked Ibrahimović's right-side cross past Pickford with his right heel; looked offside but stood | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 86th min; AFP: right heel, Ibrahimović's right-wing cross; Pogba released Ibrahimović first.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Added Pogba's pass (one source). Spots and landing estimated. | Earlier: Ibrahimović's carry before the cross and the landing spot are estimated.

goals.label: Can v Watford — the overhead kick
goals.checked: Vicarage Road, 1 May 2017, 0-1; Lucas Leiva's chip into the box, Can's scissor/overhead kick from about 15 yards into the top corner past Gomes, at the stroke of half-time | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 1-0, first-half stoppage time (two minutes in), Lucas's ball forward, top corner past Gomes; one report says top-left.

goals.checked: Anfield, 10 Dec 2017, 1-1 (Salah 42', Rooney pen 77'); Joe Gomez's pass down the right, Salah shrugged off Martina, went past Gueye and curled a left-footer around Ashley Williams into the far top corner past Pickford; 2018 Puskás Award | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Joe Gomez pass, past Martina and Gueye, curled into the far top corner / top-left corner (two reports).

goals.label: Son v Burnley — the solo run

goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): None. | Earlier: Minute 33' (one report 32'). Pass spots estimated.

goals.label: Bale v Barcelona — the sprint past Bartra
goals.technique: solo run, low finish under the keeper

goals.checked: 16 Apr 2014 at Mestalla, 2-1 Real Madrid; Di María opener, Bartra equaliser (~68'), Bale 85'. Coentrão found Bale on the left just inside his own half; Bale knocked it past Bartra, ran outside the touchline, then rolled it under Pinto. | Pass 2: Coentrão's ball down the left, Bale went off the pitch round Bartra, 85', 1-1 before (Bartra 65'); reports say he slotted inside Pinto's near post / under him.
goals.note: end moved 32.5 -> 31.4 (near post, shooter's left) per reports. Left foot not stated in sources found (from memory, very likely). Run timings estimated.

goals.label: Messi v Athletic — the Copa final solo run
goals.checked: 30 May 2015 at Camp Nou, Barcelona won 3-1 (Messi 20' and 74', Neymar, Williams). Opener: Messi from the right flank near halfway, past several players incl. Balenziaga, switched feet past Laporte, low left-foot finish at the near post from ~10 yards. | Pass 2: 20', Camp Nou, run from the right flank near halfway, low left-foot shot inside the near post from ~10 yards (Eurosport, SI). Keeper was Iago Herrerín (SI), not Iraizoz.

goals.note: Corner disputed: Sky Sports says bottom right (kept, end 36.8), Eurosport commentary says bottom left. André Gomes link pass not confirmed by search.

goals.technique: low drive at the near post
goals.checked: 20 Dec 2020, Sassuolo 1-2 Milan; Leão scored after 6.76 s (record). Kick-off routine: Çalhanoğlu surged forward and slipped him in; two touches near the edge of the box, shot at the near post past Consigli. | Pass 2: kick-off move, Çalhanoğlu found Leão, angled drive past Consigli after ~6 s (6.76 s Guinness), Milan won 2-1.
goals.note: Leão on the left channel and right foot from memory. Kick-off move simplified.

goals.label: Messi v Real Madrid — the Bernabéu slalom
goals.checked: Real Madrid 0-2 Barcelona at the Bernabéu; Messi scored both (76' from Afellay's cross, then the solo goal); give-and-go with Busquets just inside Madrid's half, past Lass Diarra, Albiol, Ramos and inside Marcelo, pushed in with his right foot past Casillas | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Eurosport 87', give-and-go with Busquets near halfway (90min), past Lass Diarra and others, past Casillas.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Made the Busquets pass a one-two. Finish corner still not in sources. | Earlier: Minute given as 87 or 88 by different reports (87 used). Route and finishing spot placed from the description (run down Barcelona's right, past Marcelo); end corner not stated in sources.

goals.label: Messi v Man United — the Wembley final strike
goals.checked: Barcelona 3-1 Man United at Wembley, 28 May 2011; Pedro 27', Rooney 34', Messi 54' (2-1), Villa 69'; Iniesta found him free, Messi drove a low left-footed shot past Van der Sar from about 25 yards | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 54th min 2-1, Iniesta found him (AFP), low shot from 20 m-30 yards; one report says down the middle, another curling away from Van der Sar's dive.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Corner and foot still not confirmed by a source. | Earlier: Distance quoted 25-30 yards (edge of area in one report); spot ~23 m used. Which corner it went in is not confirmed; low to the shooter's right assumed.

goals.label: Drogba v Bayern — the 88th-minute header
goals.checked: Bayern 1-1 Chelsea aet at the Allianz Arena (Chelsea won 4-3 on penalties); Müller 83', Drogba 88' powerful near-post header from Mata's corner (Chelsea's first), Neuer got a hand to it | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 88th min, Mata's corner, near-post header past Neuer.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Corner side still not stated; one Goal.com piece says Lampard took it (most say Mata). | Earlier: Type is Open Play because it was headed in from a corner, not scored direct. Which side the corner came from is not stated in the sources found; left side assumed, near post. Final score ignores the shoot-out.

goals.label: Robben v Dortmund — the 89th-minute winner
goals.checked: Dortmund 1-2 Bayern at Wembley; Mandžukić 60', Gündoğan pen 68', Robben 89' after Ribéry's backheel flick, slotted past Weidenfeller (one report says he scuffed it) | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 89th min, Ribéry backheel, ball played long into the area; FC Bayern: inside of the LEFT boot past Weidenfeller.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Left foot now confirmed; Boateng as the long-ball passer and the corner not confirmed. | Earlier: Long ball before the backheel (passer and spot) estimated; left foot and the corner it rolled into are not stated in the sources found.

goals.label: Ramos v Atlético — the 92:48 header
goals.checked: Real Madrid 4-1 Atlético aet in Lisbon; Godín 36', Ramos 90+3 header from Modrić's outswinging corner into the bottom corner past Courtois; Bale 110', Marcelo 118', Ronaldo pen 120' | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 93rd min header from Modrić's stoppage-time corner, Courtois no chance (UEFA).
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Corner side and which bottom corner still not stated. | Earlier: Corner from the right assumed (Modrić right-footed outswinger); which bottom corner is not stated — far side assumed.

goals.label: Ibrahimović v Anderlecht — the 25-metre volley
goals.checked: Anderlecht 0-5 PSG in Brussels; Ibrahimović scored 17', 22', 36', 62' and Cavani one; the 36' third was a first-time volley from about 25 m off Kouyaté's headed clearance; Kaminski in goal | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Group C confirmed; 36th min first-time volley from about 25 m (UEFA) off Kouyaté's headed clearance, bent away from Kaminski into the roof of the net.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Group now confirmed; side estimated. | Earlier: The last 'pass' is an Anderlecht clearance (Kouyaté, recipient none). Group letter (C) from memory, not a source. Exact spot and corner not stated; placed central-right, top left.

goals.label: Messi v Bayern — Boateng falls, the chip
goals.checked: Barcelona 3-0 Bayern at Camp Nou; Messi 77', 80', Neymar 90+4; for the second Messi took Rakitić's pass at the top of the box, Boateng fell, and he chipped Neuer with his right foot from about 6 yards | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 80th min (SI), Rakitić pass, Boateng left on the ground, right-foot chip over Neuer.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Some reports name no passer. | Earlier: Rakitić credit from one report. Spot on the right of the box from the well-known picture; chip landing point estimated.

goals.label: Sergi Roberto v PSG — the 6-1
goals.checked: Barcelona 6-1 PSG (6-5 agg) at Camp Nou; Neymar free kick 88', pen ~90+1, Sergi Roberto 90+5 stretching to poke Neymar's chipped ball past Trapp | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 95th min; Neymar lofted the ball into a crowded box after ter Stegen's ball to him; finish with the tip of the boot (FC Barcelona) / sliding stab past Trapp.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Foot still not named; placement estimated. | Earlier: Neymar's spot, Roberto's spot and the finish placement estimated; reports call it a poke/volley with an outstretched leg (right foot assumed).

goals.label: Mandžukić v Real Madrid — the Cardiff overhead kick
goals.checked: Juventus 1-4 Real Madrid in Cardiff; Ronaldo 20', Mandžukić 27' equaliser: Bonucci long ball, Alex Sandro first-time cross, Higuaín's touches, Mandžukić chest then a diagonal overhead kick from about 15 yards arcing over Navas under the bar; ball never touched the ground | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 27th min, Bonucci long ball to Alex Sandro on the left, first-time cross, Higuaín chipped/chested it on, overhead kick over Navas.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Foot still not confirmed. | Earlier: Left foot only from one write-up. Positions estimated (left side of box, far top corner from 'arcing across goal').

goals.label: Ronaldo v Juventus — the Turin overhead kick
goals.checked: Juventus 0-3 Real Madrid in Turin; Ronaldo 3' and 64', Marcelo 72'; the 64' goal was an overhead kick from Carvajal's chipped cross from the right edge of the box, past Buffon | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 64th min, Reuters: Carvajal's chipped ball, overhead kick past Buffon.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): One piece mentions a Marcelo cross-field ball earlier in the move (not added). Landing still estimated. | Earlier: Corner and height where it crossed the line not stated; placed mid-height to the shooter's left. Carvajal's carry estimated.

goals.label: Bale v Liverpool — the Kyiv overhead kick
goals.checked: Real Madrid 3-1 Liverpool in Kyiv; Benzema 51', Mané 55', Bale 64' overhead kick (left foot, top corner) from Marcelo's cross from the left, about two minutes after coming on; Bale 83' too | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 64th min, two minutes after coming on for Isco, Marcelo cross from the left, left foot, from about 15 yards over Karius.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Strike moved to 15 yards (y 13.7). Top corner side not stated. | Earlier: Which top corner is not stated; placed shooter's left. Marcelo cross: one source says right foot after cutting in. Spots estimated.

goals.label: Messi v Liverpool — the 600th-goal free kick
goals.checked: Barcelona 3-0 Liverpool at Camp Nou; Suárez 26', Messi 75', Messi 82' direct free kick (after a Fabinho foul) from 30+ yards into the top corner past Alisson; his 600th Barcelona goal | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 82nd min, left foot (SCMP), top corner past Alisson, about 30 yards (one says 25).
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Side of the top corner still not stated in any source found. | Earlier: Distance quoted 25-35 yards (~28.5 m used). Reports split on top-left v top-right; top left (far corner for a left-footer from right of centre) used. Left foot from general knowledge, not a source.

goals.label: Origi v Barcelona — corner taken quickly
goals.checked: Liverpool 4-0 Barcelona (4-3 agg) at Anfield; Origi 7', Wijnaldum x2, Origi 79' from Alexander-Arnold's quickly taken corner, into the roof of the net past ter Stegen; Origi saw the left side open | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 79th min, Alexander-Arnold's quick corner; finish described as clipped/smashed past ter Stegen; one French report: across goal into the top corner.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Corner side and first-time not confirmed. | Earlier: Corner from the right assumed (Alexander-Arnold the right-back); 'first-time' not confirmed. Type Open Play since not scored direct from the corner.

goals.label: Lucas Moura v Ajax — the 96th-minute winner
goals.checked: Ajax 2-3 Tottenham in Amsterdam (3-3 agg, Spurs through on away goals); De Ligt 5', Ziyech 35', Lucas 55', 59', 90+6; Sissoko long ball, Llorente knock-down, Dele first-time pass, Lucas left foot from about 16 yards past Onana | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 96th min, Sissoko long ball, Llorente touch, Alli flick, left foot from 16 yards, low past Onana.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Bottom corner side not in sources. | Earlier: One Dutch report says 95th minute. Bottom-left corner from general knowledge, not a source.

goals.label: Rodri v Inter — the Istanbul winner
goals.checked: Man City 1-0 Inter in Istanbul; Rodri 68' first-time shot from the top of the box, inside the near post past Onana, after Akanji fed Bernardo Silva whose cutback was deflected (Acerbi per one report) | Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): 68th min, Akanji to Bernardo Silva, pull-back (deflected, Acerbi per Goal Italia), side-foot from the edge of the box past Onana.
goals.note: Pass 2 (22 Oct 2026): Corner not confirmed beyond the earlier near-post wording. | Earlier: Deflection on the cutback not modelled. Spots estimated; low inside the (right) near post from UEFA's 'near post' wording.
